offers_products.reason: Revenue is mainly radio advertising airtime; content is free to listeners, not a sold product; concerts are events.

offers_services.reason: Radio broadcasting, advertising airtime, live concerts and events, and DigIdea digital marketing are services for advertisers and audiences.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Concert and event tickets sold to Hispanic listeners; the audience chooses and receives the programming.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Advertisers (local and national businesses) buy radio airtime, MegaTV spots, and DigIdea digital marketing.

recurring_revenue.reason: Advertisers repeatedly buy radio spots and campaigns; most revenue is ongoing broadcast advertising, though not contracted.

cyclical_demand.reason: Advertising budgets and concert spending are easily cut in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Radio ad spots and concert tickets are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from owned stations, licenses, broadcast network and content, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Advertisers include many local and small businesses plus consumers; not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Radio stations need towers and licenses, but ongoing capital needs are modest compared with heavy industries.

notes: Mix of advertisers is not detailed on the site; customer size judged from typical radio advertising.
